en: The image shows a vintage telegraph form or postcard with red and blue text, titled 'Cable and Wireless Limited'. It has both English and Greek text, with a prominent section reading 'ΤΗΛΕΓΡΑΦΕΙΟΝ ΑΘΗΝΩΝ ΤΗΛΕΓΡΑΦΗΜΑ', which translates to 'Athens Telegraph Office Telegram'. The date handwritten is '13/7/43' (13 July 1943). There is an official stamp impression and a slogan at the bottom reading 'Via Radio-Athinai'.
